newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU 3,162 TO DOLLAR FOR AUG 30-SEPT 1 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU 3,162 TO DOLLAR FOR AUG 30-SEPT 1 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,162 to the dollar for August 30 to September 1.
This reference rate was set on Wednesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for August 29 is 3,164 to the dollar. It was 3,161 on Wednesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
